ai.title: AI
ai.intro: AI in the app answers questions from your notes and helps summarize, reword and suggest links. It needs an API key: a code you create on the provider's site so the app can call their AI service, which they charge by use.
ai.subscriptionNote: A Claude Pro or Max account cannot be used inside the app. To use that account, see Connect Claude (MCP) below.

status.off: AI is off. The app sends nothing.
status.reconsent: Your consent is needed again because you changed the provider.
status.consent: Your consent is needed before AI sends anything.
status.noKey: AI is on but there is no {{provider}} API key yet. Paste one in the field below.
status.budget: AI is paused because this month's limit is used up.
status.unavailable: AI cannot run for the open vault yet. Quit and open the app again.

ai.enable: Turn on AI in the app
ai.enableHint: When you turn it on, the app shows exactly what is sent so you can agree first.

consent.title: Turn on AI with {{provider}}?
consent.lead: When you use AI in the app, the things below are sent to {{provider}} and handled under {{provider}}'s policy.
consent.sentQuestion: Your question, with the earlier questions and answers of the same conversation.
consent.sentExcerpts: A few excerpts from related notes in these folders: {{folders}}.
consent.sentNames: The names of your courses, projects and upcoming deadlines in those folders.
consent.sentSelection: The text you select when you use an AI action. For tag suggestions, also the list of tags you use.
consent.sentInbox: A whole Inbox note when you press Suggest a place, with the folder names and the names of a few related notes.
consent.neverExcluded: {{folders}}, unless you add them to the folder list.
consent.neverFiles: Attachments such as images or PDFs. Text from a PDF is only quoted when the PDF is in a chosen folder.
consent.neverKey: Your API key, except to {{provider}} itself.
consent.limit: Monthly limit: {{limit}} tokens. When it is used up, AI pauses until next month.
consent.wrong: AI can be wrong. Answers link to your notes when they can; please check them.

ai.keyEmpty: Paste the API key into the field first.
ai.keyNone: No key yet. A key stays on this computer and is never shown in full again.
ai.modelDefault: Leave empty to use the default model ({{model}}).
ai.foldersHint: AI only reads the chosen folders. By default that is every folder except 3 Resources and 4 Archive. Templates and attachments are never sent.
ai.foldersRoot: Notes at the top of the vault
ai.foldersEmpty: The vault has no folders yet.

budget.label: Monthly limit (tokens)
budget.explain: Tokens are how providers count text and charge for it; a token is a few characters. A question usually takes a few thousand tokens. The numbers here are approximate and may differ a little from the bill.
budget.invalid: The limit must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} tokens.
budget.paused: AI is paused because this month's {{limit}} tokens are used up. To go on, raise the limit above or wait until {{next}}.

embeddings.title: Search by meaning (embeddings)
embeddings.intro: Finds notes about the same idea even with other words: "notes about matrices" still finds "Linear algebra – chapter 3". This is turned on separately, with its own consent.

consent.title: Turn on search by meaning with {{provider}}?
consent.lead: To build the meaning index, the text of every note in the folders AI may read ({{folders}}) is sent to {{provider}} little by little and handled under {{provider}}'s policy.
consent.edits: When you edit a note, its text is sent again a few minutes later.
consent.search: What you type when searching, the questions you ask AI, the text you select for Suggest links and the Inbox note you press Suggest a place for are also sent to {{provider}} to search by meaning.
consent.cost: Each note costs a few tokens, counted in the monthly limit.
consent.never: Notes outside those folders, attachments and your API key (except to {{provider}} itself) are never sent.
consent.off: You can turn it off any time. Then the app sends nothing more and stops using this index.

mcp.title: Connect Claude (MCP)
mcp.intro: MCP lets Claude Desktop read and write your wiki through this app, with the Claude account you already have (no API key needed). The app enforces the permissions: Claude can only do what the app allows, even if told otherwise.

steps.install: Install and open Claude Desktop, and sign in with your Claude account.
steps.config: In Claude Desktop, open Settings, choose Developer, then click Edit Config.
steps.paste: Open the claude_desktop_config.json file that appears, paste the snippet below and save. If the file already has an mcpServers entry, add only the "second-brain" part inside it.
steps.restart: Quit Claude Desktop completely (including its tray icon), then open it again.
steps.try: Try asking Claude: "Search Second Brain for notes about matrices".

mcp.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the snippet and press Ctrl+C.
mcp.bridgeMissing: Open the app once with Mở Second Brain so it can prepare the connection file.
mcp.loadError: Could not load the snippet. Check that the server is running, then try again.
mcp.httpIntro: For apps that support MCP over HTTP. This only works while the app is open.
mcp.httpWarning: This snippet holds the app's access code. The screen shows only its last 4 characters; the Copy button copies all of it. Do not share it: anyone with this code can read and change your notes while the app is running.
mcp.noteEdits: Let AI edit your own notes
mcp.noteEditsHint: When off, Claude only writes in wiki/, adds to the Inbox and to today's daily note. When on, Claude may also change your own notes, always checking it has the latest version.
